policy.regional_variation: BISINDO varies by region; this specification follows the downloaded datasets and must remain configurable.
policy.motion_rule: A letter is deferred if credible evidence says its identity requires a trajectory rather than a held endpoint pose.

bisindo.status: provisional pending validation by a Deaf BISINDO instructor

deferred_letters.label: R
deferred_letters.reason: dynamic trajectory in the strongest direct BISINDO study; regional/static variants exist

deferred_letters.label: Z
deferred_letters.reason: complex movement reported to extend toward the shoulder; static endpoint datasets are inconsistent

sources: deferred dynamic letters shown as isolated endpoint frames

notes: Y is retained provisionally as a static two-hand pose because the animated reference shows a holdable endpoint and no strong source was found that requires a trajectory.
Z is excluded under the strict-static policy even though some image classifiers treat its endpoint as static.
The static model must support two hands; a one-hand-only feature pipeline would discard 16 of 23 classes.

sources: balanced samples from del and space while gesture controls are disabled

notes: The bundled Kaggle test directory is excluded because all 28 files are exact copies of training images.
Space and delete remain UI buttons in the MVP and are not output classes.

evidence.title: Penerapan Graph Neural Network dalam Pengenalan Alfabet BISINDO dengan Fokus pada Gerakan Dinamis
evidence.finding: The method identifies J and R as dynamic; the conclusion also describes Z as a complex letter involving movement toward the shoulder.
evidence.caveat: The study is small and its publication metadata conflicts with the PDF date.

evidence.title: A Multimodal BISINDO Corpus
evidence.finding: Provides A-Z videos and extracted frames for checking endpoint poses and motion coverage.
evidence.caveat: The public videos contain one actor and do not publish a letter-level static/dynamic table.

evidence.title: Animated BISINDO Alphabet
evidence.finding: Visual reference for A-Z and common phrases; used only to compare pose and motion, not as training data.
evidence.caveat: The dataset does not document linguistic validation or regional variety.

evidence.title: Pusat Bahasa Isyarat Indonesia
evidence.finding: BISINDO has regional variation, so a universal motion table should not be assumed.
evidence.caveat: No downloadable machine-readable alphabet specification was found.

evidence.title: ASL Alphabet Dataset
evidence.finding: Defines the 24 static ASL letters and excludes motion-based J and Z.
evidence.caveat: Used as metadata evidence only; it is not currently part of the local training data.
